rubric: An assertion fails in code the base also changed since the branch was cut: the change may have broken it, or the base moved under it. The log does not decide, so the model should hedge.

reading.why: two readings are fair; see readings

criteria.class: the change broke a test, a build or a lint rule; a fix in the code is needed

readings.why: A plain assertion failure in code the change touched: the change may have broken it.

criteria.class: the base branch moved: a conflict, a stale lockfile or a base commit the change no longer fits

readings.why: The branch is 14 commits behind and two of them changed src/pricing/, so the base may have moved under it.
